name: Client {OS}
tagline: The client relationship: expectations, comms and boundaries.

commands.name: /client-open
commands.summary: Write the expectation record and the confirmation message to send.

commands.name: /client-brief
commands.summary: Maintain the one-page account brief anyone can pick up.

commands.name: /client-update
commands.summary: Draft the cadence update in the client's language, carrying position not activity.

commands.name: /client-bad-news
commands.summary: Draft the early bad-news message with the recovery already chosen.

commands.name: /client-boundary
commands.summary: Answer an out-of-scope request: included, extra with a price, or refused with an alternative.

commands.name: /client-exception
commands.summary: Record a granted exception with its date, its reason and its normal price.

commands.name: /client-strain
commands.summary: Diagnose the cause behind the symptom and name a specific repair with an owner and a date.

commands.name: /client-health
commands.summary: Produce the health read with evidence and the revenue at risk.

commands.name: /client-close
commands.summary: Run offboarding or non-renewal as a conversation and a record.

requires_human_approval_for: sending anything at all to the client
committing to a date, a price or a deliverable
granting an exception to what was agreed
escalating to the client's superior or to a legal channel
pausing or stopping delivery, including for non-payment
ending an engagement or declining a renewal
sharing internal position, cost or capacity information externally
